subject: SIG request: SDLC attestation — CI/CD controls, secrets handling, PR timeline
messages:
From: Samantha Lee <sam.lee@northbridge.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 7 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SIG: SDLC evidence request — CI/CD & secrets

Hi Vivek,

As part of Northbridge's SIG intake (follow-up from our QBR), we need a short attestation and supporting artifacts for Redwood's Secure SDLC controls. Focus areas below — target turnaround: 5 business days (requested by 2027-07-13):

- PR review evidence: sample PR IDs + reviewer history for last 6 months (we do not need every PR, but a representative set across infra, runtime, and control-plane repos).
- CI/CD logs: build+deploy run logs for the corresponding PRs (redacted is fine; please indicate what is redacted).
- Secrets management: rotation policy, KMS/HSM usage, any ephemeral token enforcement for CI runners, and rotation logs.
- Change approvals: manifest showing approvals/owners for production deploys, and the rollback/incident playbook reference.

Can you confirm scope and whether you can provide an initial bundle by next Friday (2027-07-09) and a complete package by 2027-07-12? If any items require NDAs/controls, flag them and we can route.

Thanks — if you prefer a quick call, happy to schedule.

Best,
Samantha Lee
Security Assessment Lead, Northbridge Financial
sam.lee@northbridge.com
Audit team: audit@northbridge.com
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <sam.lee@northbridge.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 7 Jul 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG: SDLC evidence request — CI/CD & secrets

Samantha — thanks for the clear ask. Looping in Marissa (security program lead), Kimberly (eng security), and Jonas (compliance) to help collate. Proposed plan: 

- Initial bundle by 2027-07-09 containing: a representative PR timeline CSV, CI pipeline run logs for those PRs (redacted tokens), and the secrets rotation policy + summary rotation logs.
- Full manifest (including change approval mapping and deploy tags) by 2027-07-12.

Notes/constraints:
- We will deliver artifacts with token/credential masking; we will annotate each file explaining what was redacted and why.
- Some HSM/KMS key material is non-exportable; we will provide KMS configuration screenshots and audit entries instead.

Marissa/Kim — can you confirm attachment names and whether we should include the deploy-tag -> PR mapping in the initial bundle or in the follow-up?

If Northbridge needs any specific format for the PR samples (e.g., CSV columns), let us know and we will adapt.

-Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Compliance & Trust, Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <sam.lee@northbridge.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 9 Jul 2027 08:47:22 -07:00
Subject: Delivering initial SDLC evidence bundle (per request)

Hi Samantha — attaching the initial bundle we discussed. Attachment stubs below; full zip uploaded to shared Drive link (see related links).

Attachments included (files are attachments in this thread):
- ci_pipeline_logs.zip (contains redacted build & deploy logs for the sample PRs; redaction: ephemeral tokens and full env var values)
- pr-timeline.csv (columns: repo, pr_id, author, reviewers, opened_at, merged_at, labels)
- secrets-rotation-policy.pdf (policy text; includes rotation cadence and scope)
- rotation-logs.csv (timestamped rotation events for managed secrets; partial UUIDs shown)
- change_approval_manifest.csv (prod deploy ID, associated PR, approver(s), approval timestamp)

Summary highlights:
- PR process: All production-affecting PRs require two independent reviewers and a security signoff label for infra/runtime repos. The pr-timeline.csv shows reviewer counts and security label presence.
- CI/CD: Our pipelines run in ephemeral runners that use short-lived service tokens; those tokens are minted via our internal token service and rotated every 12 hours. The ci_pipeline_logs.zip includes a README that describes what was redacted.
- Secrets: We use cloud KMS for key storage; critical keys are HSM-backed and non-exportable. rotation-logs.csv shows automated rotations and manual rotations tied to incident responses.
- Change approvals: change_approval_manifest.csv maps deploy IDs to PRs and approvers; for emergency fixes we have an expedited approval record and linked rollback playbook reference.

A few caveats: some logs include transient IP addresses (we can mask on request), and per our policy we cannot export raw KMS key material — instead we provide KMS audit entries and access policy extracts.

Related links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcDeFgHIjkLmno (bundle), HubSpot-Deal-7890 (ticket).

If you want, Kim and I can walk through the bundle in a 20-minute call tomorrow.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Security Program Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Samantha Lee <sam.lee@northbridge.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 9 Jul 2027 15:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Delivering initial SDLC evidence bundle (per request)

Marissa/Team — received, thanks. Quick clarifications after a brief pass through the bundle: 

1) pr-timeline.csv looks good — can you add the deploy_tag column (or provide a small mapping file) so we can trace PR -> deploy artifact?
2) rotation-logs.csv: can you confirm whether ephemeral runner tokens are fully enforced to be short-lived (12 hours) for third-party PR builds as well, or only for internal branches? We need to document that for our control matrix.

If you can reply to those two items (even as short bullets) by EOD Monday 2027-07-12, that should be sufficient to close the SIG ticket. If it helps, let's do the 20-minute review call Monday morning.
